import polars as pl


def transform(raw: pl.DataFrame) -> pl.DataFrame:
    null_values = ["", "N/A", "n/a", "-", "null"]

    return raw.select(
        device_id=pl.col("Sensor ID").str.to_uppercase(),
        read_at=pl.col("Recorded At").str.strptime(
            pl.Datetime("us"), format="%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", strict=False
        ),
        temperature_c=pl.col("Temp (C)")
        .str.to_lowercase()
        .replace(null_values, None)
        .cast(pl.Float64, strict=False)
        .round(2),
        humidity_pct=pl.col("Humidity (%)")
        .str.to_lowercase()
        .replace(null_values, None)
        .cast(pl.Float64, strict=False)
        .round(2),
        battery_v=pl.col("Battery (V)")
        .str.to_lowercase()
        .replace(null_values, None)
        .cast(pl.Float64, strict=False)
        .round(2),
    )
